welcome.tagline: See what is taking up space on your Mac.
welcome.previousScans: Previous scans — open instantly, rescan when you want
welcome.cacheSizeHint: Disk space this saved scan uses
welcome.clearCachesHint: Delete all saved scans. Your files are not touched.
welcome.emptyTrashHint: Permanently erase everything in the Trash
welcome.fdaOffDetail: some folders (Mail, Safari, other apps' data) can't be measured.
welcome.fdaDevHint: Running with npm run tauri dev? Grant access to the app that launched it (VS Code / iTerm). For the built app, click + and pick DiskLens.app.
welcome.taglineOther: See what is taking up space on your computer.
welcome.dropHint: Tip: drop a folder onto this window to scan it.
welcome.cacheInMemoryHint: Kept in memory — gone when the app closes
welcome.cacheRamNotice: The disk is nearly full, so some scans are kept in RAM only and will be lost when the app closes.

disk.scanStoppedPrevious: Scan stopped — showing previous result from {{when}}
disk.stillScanning: Still scanning — folders open once sizing finishes
disk.waitForScan: Wait for the current scan to finish
disk.stale: Scanned {{when}} — files may have changed since then.
disk.unreadableHint: Folders the app could not read
disk.selectHint: Select all · shift-click for a range
disk.cleanupTitle: Safe to clean in this folder

disk.cleanupHint_other: {{count, number}} cache and build folders, {{size}}. These are rebuilt automatically.
disk.changesTitle: What changed since the previous scan
disk.changesHint: Biggest growth and shrinkage since the previous scan of this folder (10 MB or more).
disk.noPreviousScan: Rescan this folder later to see what changed since now.
disk.noChanges: Nothing changed by 10 MB or more.
disk.oldOnlyHint: Only files not modified in the last year
disk.noOldFiles: No large files untouched for a year.
disk.sincePreviousHint: Compared with the previous scan — click to see what changed

treemap.bundle: App bundle. Open it to read its contents.

delete.permanentNote: This skips the Trash and frees {{size}} immediately. It cannot be undone.
delete.sureNote: {{size}} in {{what}} will be erased forever. There is no way to recover it.
delete.trashNote_one: You can restore it from the Trash. The {{size}} is only freed after you empty the Trash.
delete.trashNote_other: You can restore them from the Trash. The {{size}} is only freed after you empty the Trash.
delete.riskyWarning_one: {{count, number}} item ({{size}}) holds app data, mail, photos, system files or a Git history. Deleting it may break an app or lose data.
delete.riskyWarning_other: {{count, number}} items ({{size}}) hold app data, mail, photos, system files or a Git history. Deleting them may break apps or lose data.

apps.title: Applications
apps.refreshHint: Reload the app list and re-measure
apps.allUpToDate: Everything checkable is up to date
apps.checkedHint: Checked {{count, number}} App Store / Sparkle apps. Others update themselves.
apps.unusedHint: Not opened in the last 3 months (or never)
apps.uninstall: Uninstall — move app & data to Trash
apps.resetDataHint: Removes settings and caches; the app starts fresh next time
apps.safetyNote: Quit the app first. Data is matched only by bundle id or exact app name, so other apps' files are never included.

dev.title: Developer
dev.noFolders: Shared caches only — add a projects folder
dev.warningsTitle: Problems in your rules file — those rules were skipped

safetyHint.safe: Comes back by itself when needed
safetyHint.rebuild: Needs a command to bring it back
safetyHint.caution: May hold something you can't get back

dev.ageHint: Untouched for at least this long
dev.customHint: From your rules file. Quick-select skips it.
dev.viewOnlyHint: Outside your home folder, so it can't be deleted here.
dev.copyRestore: Copy the command that brings it back
dev.wtHint: Worktrees are whole checkouts. Turn on Caution to see them.
dev.selectStaleHint: Safe and Rebuild items in projects untouched for {{days}}+ days
dev.selectOldHint: Every version but the newest, skipping Caution items
dev.rulesSaved: Rules saved — they apply on the next scan
dev.changedOutside: The rules file was changed outside DiskLens while you were editing.
dev.deletedOutside: The rules file was deleted outside DiskLens while you were editing.
dev.keepMineHint: Saving will overwrite the file's version
dev.turnOffHint: Adds an override that turns this rule off
dev.customizeHint: Copies the built-in definition into your file to change it
dev.noRulesArray: Couldn't find the "rules" list in your file
dev.editorHint: JSON with comments. A built-in id changes only the fields you set; a new id adds a rule.
dev.rulesChangedOutside: The rules file changed since this scan.

donate.title: Support the project
donate.heading: Enjoying DiskLens?
donate.pitch: It's free, open source and has no ads or tracking. If it freed up space for you, a small donation helps keep it maintained.
donate.kofiHint: One-time or monthly · card or PayPal
donate.paypalHint: Send any amount directly via PayPal

summary.note: Scanned sizes count what the app could read. They can differ from the disk's used space because of APFS snapshots, purgeable space, other volumes and folders without permission.

safety.safeHint: Caches, logs and build output that apps recreate
safety.reviewHint: Your own files and apps. Check before deleting
safety.riskyHint: System files, app data, mail, photo libraries, Git history
safety.unknownHint: Outside the folders the app knows about

hidden.title: Space hidden from folder scans
hidden.purgeableHint: Caches and files macOS frees on its own when the disk runs low
hidden.confirmBody: Local snapshots are hourly copies Time Machine keeps on this disk. Backups on your backup drive are not touched; you only lose the ability to restore from the last few hours offline.
hidden.someLeftHint: macOS may keep snapshots it is still using; try again later.

app.dropToScan: Drop a folder to scan it
app.dropFolderOnly: Drop a folder, not a file

photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Finds blurry photos, screenshots and near-identical shots in the folders above. Nothing is deleted until you choose.
photos.noHeic: HEIC photos can't be read on this system; they are only checked by name.
photos.truncated: Stopped at the first 20,000 images; add fewer folders to check the rest.
photos.quickLookHint: Space to preview · double-click to open
photos.sharpHint: Larger thumbnails that stay crisp on high-resolution screens (a little slower to load)

cacheMode.label: Save scans to
cacheMode.autoHint: Disk, or memory when the disk is nearly full
cacheMode.memoryHint: Keep scans in memory only; they are gone when the app closes

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: This opens a pre-filled GitHub issue. DiskLens sends nothing itself: you read the text below and submit it yourself.
report.crashCount: Crash logs saved on this computer: {{count}}
report.attachHint: If DiskLens crashed, attach the newest file from the crash logs folder to the issue.

stats.title: Share an anonymous launch count?
stats.description: DiskLens can count how many people open it each day. It sends only the app version and your OS, never file names, paths or scan results. Crash logs stay on your computer and are never sent.
